The transmission inner function previously multiplied the selected operational variable by `efficiency[idx]`, but now returns the selected variable without applying efficiency, despite still computing it. For example, a transmitting Link with port-1 efficiency 0.8 and nonzero flow now contributes the full flow rather than 0.8 times that flow. This difference also occurs under legacy semantics with the default snapshot-index option.
